title: What If You Swallowed Your Gum? Not Seven Years

scenes.text: What if you swallowed your gum? It does not stay for seven years.
That myth is old. Experts say swallowed gum travels through you in about 40 hours, just like food.
Gum base is a synthetic material. Your body has no enzymes that can break it down.
So the gum doesn't dissolve. It passes through your intestines mostly intact and leaves with everything else.
The sweeteners and flavors do get digested. Only the rubbery base takes the trip unchanged.
One piece is harmless. Only large wads swallowed again and again have blocked children's intestines, on very rare occasions.
